### Gun reference photos, batch of 2026-11-15 (drawing references only, never shown in the game)
- AK-74 (VK74): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Ak74l.png - Sergey Sandalov (sAg-), CC BY-SA 3.0. Level, muzzle right, used as it was.
- Remington 870 (RangerP8): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Remington_870_Wmaster.jpg - Burnyburnout, CC BY-SA 4.0. Cut out of its wooden floor by colour (some floor specks remained under the barrel).
- SKS (SKNKarabin): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Simonov-SKS-45.JPG - public domain (original uploader BigBattles, cropped). Background whitened.
- MP5 (CorvanWasp9): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Heckler_%26_Koch_MP5-1_(cropped).jpg - Samuli Silvennoinen, CC BY-SA 3.0. A 3/4 view, mirrored to face right: the weakest reference of the batch (the side-on Bizon photo could not be fetched, Wikimedia rate limit).

### Gun reference pictures, tenth batch (2026-11-15), supplied by Yan (provenance unknown, drawing references only)
- A tactical AK-74 drawing (a stock-image illustration, white background; used for the VK-74 Obelisk), an RSh-12 revolver render on black (RK-12 Kuvalda, mirrored), a sawed-off double-barrel shotgun photo (Obrez-66, mirrored), an M240-type belt-fed machine gun photo (PL-62 Kobza, mirrored and levelled 6.5 degrees). Pasted into the chat; cut-outs in `ArtSource/weapons/spritecook_pilot/batch10/*_ref.png`. The AK-74 image carries a stock-photo watermark text on the original: only the gun was cut out, and it was used as a shape reference.
